rca_of_issue.issue: BacktestPage.js infinite loop causing 403 rate limit errors
rca_of_issue.root_cause: useCallback on line 47-61 has 'api' in dependency array. The 'api' object from useApi() hook is recreated on every render, causing useCallback to return a new function reference, which triggers the useEffect on line 63-66 to re-run, calling runBacktest() infinitely.
reproduction_steps: 4. Check console - 403 errors from Cloudflare rate limiting
rca_of_issue.mitigation: Remove 'api' from useCallback dependencies, or memoize the api object in useApi hook using useMemo
